description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Revocation of Order made to appoint Mr. V. Vimalarajah as the Arbitrator for the Industrial Dispute between Mr. B. A. Indradasa and Sri Lanka Transport Board and appoint Mr. R. S. Ariyapperuma as the Arbitrator - Revocation of Order made to appointed Mr. K. R. M. N. Lawrence as the Arbitrator for the Industrial Dispute between Mr. P. G. R. Piyaratne and Sri Lanka Transport Board and appointed Mr. S. Kariyawasam as the Arbitrator
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders and revocations of orders for arbitration in industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act) and legal procedures for dispute resolution, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does so in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing portfolio responsibilities or making personnel appointments.
